title: fix(cli): name default Gemini TTS output according to its WAV content t…
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: The Pollinations CLI now names default audio output `speech.wav` when the response has an `audio/wav` content type, so Gemini TTS output gets a filename that matches its WAV bytes. Explicit `--output` paths, timestamp output, and filenames for other response types remain unchanged. Added a regression test for the saved WAV bytes and reported path, and bumped `@pollinations/cli` from 0.1.47 to 0.1.48.
